visualEvidence.method: Opened actual final desktop.png, mobile.png, preview.png with the image view tool; also inspected full-page and lab captures.
visualEvidence.desktop: Clear forest-green orbital hero, yellow primary action, restrained navigation, consistent editorial spacing, aligned three-column lesson grid.
visualEvidence.mobile: Readable single-column layout and responsive controls. Headline reduced to 39px to avoid an extra line; real solar art is retained below the action.
visualEvidence.lab: Scrolled mobile laboratory retains sticky close control. Safety, method, controls, observations and challenge remain available without horizontal overflow.
visualEvidence.limitations: 1200x900 official preview is a first-screen screenshot; full-page captures are supplemental and fixed rails may appear at the restored scroll offset.

limitations: 本轮交付为静态首页适配，非完整生产 AR 平台。
太阳系为 Canvas 三维坐标投影，展示六颗行星，体积和距离压缩；无摄像头 AR 或硬件追踪。
单摆使用小角度无阻尼模型；记录为数学仿真预测，并非真实传感器数据。
书籍扫描为明确标注的示例模拟；不执行实际识别，也不申请敏感权限。
身份认证、家长同意服务、教师 CMS、多人联机、加密用户资料和原始增强/高级路线图未实现。
没有离线安装、多语言课程、COPPA/WCAG 认证或设备性能保证；仅本地课程进度持久化。
原始技术栈为未填模板，本轮授权以无构建 HTML/CSS/JavaScript 实现；未运行不存在的 npm lint/typecheck，已执行语法和浏览器检查。
task\TASK.md 不存在；本轮明确指定单一任务的授权和完整 job 作为范围依据。
